voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: Odysseus debates whether to clasp Nausicaa's knees or speak from a distance.

voice.speaker: nausicaa
voice.caption: Stranger, you seem neither base nor witless, and Zeus deals fortune as he wills — what he gives, a man must bear. But you have come to our land now, and you shall lack neither clothing nor anything owed a hard-tried suppliant. Stand, girls — this man is no enemy; wash him where the river gives shelter, and set food and oil beside him.

keys.beat: Odysseus debates whether to clasp Nausicaa's knees or speak from a distance.
Nausicaa answers with courage and assigns the maids to help him.
